mission.name: Kaydence — Plan of Attack v3
mission.tagline: Speak anywhere. Ship clean text. Never leak, never lose, never lag.
mission.northStar: Own the machine, the voice, and the fleet: a local-first dictation platform whose flagship trio (Voiceprint, Relay, Conductor) no cloud incumbent can copy without abandoning its business model. Privacy line = transmission + persistence, not awareness (ADR-0006). Pay-once, three desktops, one behavior.

policies.notes: auto = merge own branch to main when all phase gates + standing gates are green with fresh evidence. No git remote configured, so 'PR' = local mission/ branch merged to main; GitHub 3-OS CI cannot run here (macOS-only host). Standing gates: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test (3-OS via CI), npm run check, scripts/bench.sh --check (once it lands), scripts/audit-network.sh (network-adjacent changes). Critical decision paths (JUDGE-AUDITOR.md: non-negotiable reinterpretation, new dependency/network surface, platform code, model registry, cleanup/prediction/Relay-crypto prompt contracts) HALT for operator go + ADR.

phases.title: The Flagship Trio
phases.goal: Voiceprint first (extends learning already flowing), Relay second (crypto design review gates the build), Conductor third (MCP substrate -> targets -> confirm gates -> fleet mode). Exit: all three daily-usable across the fleet; ladder targets hit; Harbor optional and unbuilt without blocking anything.

No GitHub remote configured — no CI trust anchor and no real PRs; auto-merge is local-only.
P3-BENCH requires the two physical reference machines (M-series Mac + mid-range Windows laptop) to lock ADR-0007 prediction defaults before P3.5.

Critical-path bootstrap items (P0-T1 non-negotiable #5 change, P0-T7 ADR-0009/0010) need explicit operator go per policy.
conventions: One work unit = one branch (mission/<phaseId>-<slug>) = one merge; <=400 changed lines.
Run the internal loop per prompts/BUILD-LOOP.md (ORIENT->PLAN->BUILD->JUDGE->AUDIT->GATE) inside each task; mission-control governs phases/state/reporting above it.
No authority without evidence: every 'done' has an artifact saved under ops/mission/evidence/.
A green Judge with a red Audit does not merge.
Critical decision paths (JUDGE-AUDITOR.md) HALT for operator go + ADR — never merge one silently.
Heartbeat after every merge: update state.json, run node ops/mission/render-sotu.mjs, append journal.md, commit state+journal+HTML.
Never weaken a non-negotiable to pass a gate — that is itself a blocking defect.
